observations: body L23, L28: heavy brackets close the addition begun on p. 227 (L23) and open that of L28, which goes on to p. 229.

body L2, L5, L25, L28-L30, L33, L36: the dashes of «al–Battānī» and «ar–Raqqah» are long dashes (5.3 to 5.5 pt); that of «’l–qarnayn» (L25) measures 4.1 pt, longer than a hyphen; that of «’l-qar.» (L36) is a hyphen (2.6 pt).
body L22-L24, L26: the dashes before «Numeri», «Schiaparelli» and «In canone», after «h)» in the head and between «22» and «pag.» measure 10.0 to 10.4 pt and are transcribed as dashes.
body L9-L18: the numbers of the codex and of Plato that are corrupt are printed in italics; the dots stand where Halley proposes no number.

body L10-L18: col. I gives the results of p. 227; col. II puts the true Moon equal to the true Sun, 139° 14′ 20″, so that the mean longitude 139° 14′ 20″ − 2° 5′ 48″ = 137° 8′ 32″ is 2′ 50″ greater, and so are the true anomaly (333° 12′ 57″) and the motions in latitude (174° 45′ 22″, 176° 51′ 10″).

body L17-L18: for the middle of the eclipse the table adds 4′ 5″ to the true motion in latitude (176° 52′ 25″, 176° 55′ 15″), p. 227 4′ 8″ (176° 52′ 28″). For col. II, 180° − 176° 55′ 15″ = 3° 4′ 45″ from the node, al-Battānī's table of the latitude (0° 15′ 40″ at 3°, 0° 20′ 53″ at 4°) gives 0° 16′ 5″; the print has 0° 16′ 12″.
body L21: the numbers are written in Maghribi abjad, in which س counts 300: «قلز» 137, «قلد» 134, «سلج يج» 333 13, «سلب نز» 332 57. The ز of «قلز» and of «نز» is printed without its dot.

body L25-L26: 22 kānūn II of the year 1212 of the era, which began on 1 October 900, is 22 January 901. «20h 1/8» stands for 20h 1/3: al-Battānī's 3 2/3 hours before noon of 23 kānūn II (p. 56) are 20h 20m of the 22nd, as in note 10 of p. 56 and in L29.
body L29-L33: 3 1/2 hours before noon at ar-Raqqah are 20h 30m; the equation of days of Aquarius 8° in al-Battānī's table (Part II, p. 61) is 0° 15′ = 1m; 20h 29m + 50m = 21h 19m.

body L36-L38: the motions are those of al-Battānī's tables (Part II, pp. 72, 74 and 75), save that «299° 15′ 30″» is 299° 15′ 50″ on p. 72, the 165° 40′ 17″ of 1191 and the 133° 35′ 33″ of 20 years; the sum on p. 229, 312° 50′ 6″, is made with 50″.
notes_right L3: «μεσημβρία» is printed in a small Greek type.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
